lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Ben and I are having a few people over tomorrow. Would you like to come over for dinner?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That sounds great. What time?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Six thirty.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That works for me. How many people are coming?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Six, including you: Ben, our daughter, me, two neighbors, and you.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Hi, Daniel. Let's make a list now that we know the head count.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sure. Can I bring anything?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: We could use some sparkling water.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sure. How many bottles do you need?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Did you say two or three?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Two. We already have a few bottles of juice.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: How much ice do we have?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Not much. There's only a little in the freezer.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I can bring one bag of ice too.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Thanks. Do we have any salad ingredients?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: We have some lettuce, but we don't have any tomatoes.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Then I'll buy a few tomatoes. How many pizzas do we need?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Let's order three large pizzas. We only need a few snacks after that.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Let me check: two bottles of sparkling water and one bag of ice.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Right. That's everything.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thanks for having me. Dinner was great.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I'm glad you came. There's only a little salad left.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: The list worked: three pizzas, some salad, a few snacks, and enough to drink.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: And no unopened bags of food.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Exactly. We bought what we needed.
